value.rationale: The two straight diagonal cuts are natural half-area, discontinuous observations of the same elementary chaotic map. The exact result shows that equal means and similar geometry give very different finite-time dependence: one pair is independent at time one and negatively correlated thereafter, while the other is always positively correlated. It gives an exact correlation benchmark with the sharp n·2^-n scale and sign cancellation in the sum; a qualitative mixing bound would not supply these facts. No extension to unrelated polygon sensors or periodic-orbit statistics is claimed.
